description: This file defines the interface for Android's ALooper, a low-level event loop mechanism for handling file descriptor events within threads. It includes function declarations, enums, and type definitions related to preparing, managing, and polling the looper, as well as adding and removing file descriptors and handling callbacks.

methods.name: ALooper_forThread
methods.description: Returns the looper associated with the calling thread, or NULL if none exists.

methods.name: ALooper_prepare
methods.description: Prepares and returns a looper associated with the calling thread, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: ALooper_pollOnce
methods.description: Polls for events with a specified timeout, invoking callbacks for ready file descriptors.

methods.name: ALooper_pollAll
methods.description: Performs all pending callbacks until all data is consumed or a file descriptor is ready; deprecated in API 34.

methods.name: ALooper_wake
methods.description: Wakes the looper asynchronously from any thread.

methods.name: ALooper_addFd
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to the looper for monitoring, with optional callback.

methods.name: ALooper_removeFd
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from the looper.

methods.name: ALooper_acquire
methods.description: Increases reference count on the looper to prevent deletion.

methods.name: ALooper_release
methods.description: Decreases reference count on the looper, allowing deletion if count reaches zero.
